alana: Quick sync — post-launch miniwave plan. Customers flagged reliability issues + some UI polish requests. Propose 3 lanes: hot (customer-blocking, 48h TTR), stability (top regressions, 60% eng capacity for 2w), polish (small UX PRs, 40% capacity). Thoughts? :eyes:

mike: Sounds good. Need owners and oncall plan if we pull 60% into stability.

jasmin: From telemetry: 8 high regressions (streaming disconnects, token errors), ~15 medium, 10 low. 3 customer-blocking reports. Recommend auto-promote any streaming/KV-cache regression.

omar: Two affected customers are Dedicated; they want ETA and a hotfix channel. I can handle customer comms.

rachel: Design can batch 3 polish items into small PRs. Ill own reviews.

alana: Action items: mike -> triage & assign hot lane owners today; jasmin -> publish stability sprint plan by EOD; rachel -> open polish PRs by tomorrow noon; omar -> notify customers with TTRs. Mid-sprint check Friday 16:00 PT.

product-bot: Canary deploy reminder 18:00 PT for quick patch.

mike: Will post owners in thread by 10:30.

jasmin: If new P1 surfaces we escalate to hot. Criteria: customer-blocking OR error-rate spike >1% with trace OR Dedicated incident.

alana: Target for the miniwave: close top 10 bugs + ship 4 quick wins. Re-evaluate at mid-sprint if needed.

omar: Customer messages sent; one requested a call, scheduling now.

rachel: PRs opened and ready for review tomorrow.

mike: Assigned: @jasmin (streaming), @leo (latency), @maya (Dedicated fixes).

alana: Thanks — closing.
